title: Production of homozygous rose line derived from heterozygous genotype
protocol: Harvest flower buds at different development stages.
Prepare a 5 μg/mL DAPI working solution in citrate/phosphate buffer containing Triton X-100.
Dilacerate 2-3 anthers in the DAPI solution on a microscope slide.
Remove anther debris and apply a coverslip.
Observe with fluorescence microscope under UV excitation to identify cytological stage.
Surface-sterilize buds with Pursept® A Xpress for 1 minute.
Treat buds with a bleach solution (1.5% active chlorine) containing 0.5% Tween 20 for 15 minutes, stirring periodically.
Thoroughly rinse buds 4 times with sterile de-ionized water.
Dissect anthers from buds longitudinally using a scalpel blade.
Harvest anthers with forceps and transfer them into a glass vial containing 6 mL of B medium.
Stir the mixture for 2-3 minutes at 1500 rpm until it becomes milky.
Filter the resulting suspension through a 40 µm cell strainer.
Centrifuge the filtrate at 100 g for 3 minutes.
Discard the supernatant and remove the top green layer of the two-layered pellet using a pipette.
Resuspend the whitish pellet in 6 mL B medium and centrifuge at 65 g for 3 minutes.
Discard the supernatant and repeat the resuspension step once more.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the microspore pellet in 3 mL B medium.
Pipette a 100 µL aliquot for cell counting and FCR/DAPI assays.
Add FDA to the microspore suspension at 2 µg/mL.
Observe the microspore suspension with a fluorescence microscope under blue excitation.
Determine microspore number in the purified fraction using a Malassez counting chamber.
Optional: check microspore cytological stages with DAPI staining applied to a microspore suspension aliquot.
Adjust microspore density to 100,000 microspores/mL with B medium.
Keep the microspore suspension at 4°C in darkness for 21 days in Falcon 353001 Petri dishes sealed with Parafilm®.
Rinse microspores twice with cold B medium with centrifugations at 50 g for 3 min at 4°C.
Suspend fractions containing about 160,000 microspores in 600 µL of AT12 medium.
Incubate the suspension in a 12-well plate sealed with Parafilm® at 25°C in the dark.
After 3 weeks, replace the medium with 600 µL of fresh AT12 medium by carefully pipeting with a P200 micropipet; re-seal the 12-well plate with Parafilm® and continue incubation at 25°C in the dark.
Observe for developing micro-calli (ca. 0.5 mm diameter), which start to be seen about 8 weeks after subculture.
Isolate developing micro-calli under the stereo-microscope by carefully pipetting them with a P200 micropipet (with cut tip).
Subculture isolated calli individually in 300 µL of AT12 medium in a 24-well plate sealed with Parafilm® in the same conditions.
After 2 weeks, plate individual calli onto CM3 solid medium in 100 x 20 mm round tissue culture dishes (30 mL medium per dish).
Incubate dishes at 25°C in darkness.
Subculture developing calli after 7 weeks of culture on CM3 medium for 12 weeks.
Check for somatic embryos in the calli.
Harvest developing calli for DNA isolation and propagate them by repeated subcultures every 4-6 weeks on callus maintenance medium.
Propagate embryogenic calli by repeated subcultures of embryogenic tissues on EMM.
Dissect cotyledons from embryogenic calli and plate them onto SIM.
Incubate dissected cotyledons at 25°C with a 16/8h day/night regime for 4 weeks.
Dissect regenerated shoots after 4 weeks and transfer them to multiplication medium.
Incubate the dissected shoots at 22°C with a 16/8h day/night regime.
Subculture and maintain regenerated plantlets in the same conditions every 4 weeks.
Proceed with High Resolution Melting (HRM) analyses using primer pairs known to amplify heterozygous loci.
Use Applied MeltDoctor TM HRM master mix from ThermoFisher Scientific following the manufacturer’s instructions.
Use SSR primers amplifying single heterozygous loci distributed along the chromosomes/genetic linkage groups.
Observe the k-mer spectrum of Illumina reads derived from this homozygous material to confirm homozygosity.
Isolate nuclei from homozygous calli samples or from young leaves of regenerated plantlets.
Stain the isolated nuclei by adding 1 µg/ml DAPI for 1 hour at room temperature.
Perform FACS analysis using MACSQuant VYB cytometer.
Analyze the data with FlowJo software.
Compare the ploidy profile of the homozygous material with that of the heterozygous mother plant used as a control.
